cues.text: Good morning. World Tours. My name is Jamie. How can I help you?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: Good morning. I want some information on self-drive tours in the USA. Could you send me a brochure?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Of course. Could I have your name please?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: Andrea Brown.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Thank you. And your address?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: 24, Ardleigh Road.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Can you spell that?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: A-R-D-L-E-I-G-H Road.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Postcode?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: BH5 2OP
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Thanks. And can I have your phone number?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: Is a mobile alright?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Fine.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: Thank you. And can I ask you where you heard about World Tours? From a friend? Or did you see an advert somewhere?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: No, I read about you in the newspaper.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: OK, I’ll get the brochures in the post to you but can I give you some information over the phone. What kinds of things do you want to do on your holiday?
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: I’m interested in going to California with my family. I’ve got two children and we want to hire a car.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: OK. We have a couple of self-drive tours there visiting different places of interest in California. The first one begins in Los Angeles and there’s plenty of time to visit some of the theme parks there.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: That’s something on my children’s list so I’d want to include that.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Good. Then you drive to San Francisco. From San Francisco you can drive to Yosemite Park where you spend a couple of nights. You can choose to stay in a lodge or on the campsite.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: I don’t like the idea of staying in a tent. It’d be too hot.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Right. And the tour ends in Las Vegas.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: The other trip we can arrange is slightly different. It starts in San Francisco. Then you drive south to Cambria.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: Someone told me there’s a really nice castle near Cambria. Will we go near that?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Hearst Castle is on that road so you could stop there.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: Good. I’d like to do that. Does this trip also go into the desert?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: No, it continues to Santa Monica where most people like to stop and do some shopping.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: We have enough of that at home so that doesn’t interest us.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: OK. Well you could go straight on to San Diego.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: That’s good for beaches isn’t it?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: That’s right, that’s a good place to relax and your children might like to visit the zoo before flying home.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: I don’t think so. We want some time for sunbathing and swimming.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: So how many days are the trips and how much do they cost?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: The first one I told you about is a self-drive tour through California which lasts twelve days and covers 2,020 kilometres. The shortest journey is 206 km and the longest is 632 kilometres. The cost is £525 per person. That includes accommodation, car rental and a flight but no meals.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: OK. And the other trip?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: That lasts nine days but you spend only three days on the road. You cover about 980 kilometres altogether.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: So is that cheaper then?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: Yes, it’s almost a hundred pounds cheaper. It’s £429 per person, which is a good deal.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: So that covers accommodation and car hire. What about flights?
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: They aren’t included. But these hotels offer dinner in the price.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: OK. Well, thank you very much. I’ll be in touch when I’ve had a chance to look at the brochure.
cues.speaker: ANDREA

cues.text: I’m pleased to help. Goodbye.
cues.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT

cues.text: Goodbye.
cues.speaker: ANDREA
